title: LOOT IN SIGHT AT EVERY START
why: His answer g-43: Yes, loot in sight. Baseline v37.53 missed 53 of 144 spawn checks on six seeds across both maps. Watch: does every start show a box in the first seconds, does the opening become too rich, and do both players converge on the same box.
now: Career and demo starts reuse a visible ordinary box or try up to 24 clear reachable positions for a one-second crate. Side stream 80 preserves the main stream and gives both windows the same boxes. No markers or extra text. LINKED REVIEW NEEDED: synced (g.containers).
